text: (1) the fuzhou university admission application form (with the fujian provincial government foreign student scholarship application form), please to the following web page download: https://oce.fzu.edu.cn/info/1025/7674.htm(2) A copy of my passport, valid until after December 30, 2025.Those who fall under the third item of the "Application Conditions" must submit the first page of a valid ordinary passport, the entry and exit stamps, the "birth certificate" and "naturalization certificate" issued by the passport-issuing country, as well as the valid identification documents of their parents. Applicants of overseas Chinese (including former Chinese citizens who have acquired foreign nationality and their foreign descendants, as well as foreign descendants of Chinese citizens) are required to provide relevant materials for nationality determination.(3) Three recent color passport-sized photos without a cap. Specification: 2 inches (3.5*5.3 cm), blue background without borders, the head occupies 2/3 of the photo size. The name should be noted on the back of the paper photo.Please note: Email the electronic version of the photo to: faoadmission@fzu.edu.cn. The photo size should be no less than 320*240 pixels, the aspect ratio should be 4:3, the size should be 100-500KB, and the email subject should be country + passport name.(4) A notarized high school diploma or pre-graduation certificate. The pre-graduation certificate must be stamped with the official seal of the school.(5) Scanned copies of all academic transcripts during high school that have been notarized. The transcript should have the official seal of the school. Other internationally recognized standardized test results can be provided as a reference.(6) Two recommendation letters. The letter should be written in either Chinese or English and must include the recommender's name, organization, position, contact information, etc. (Please note: A recommendation letter with incomplete information is invalid.) It should be signed by the recommender himself/herself or stamped with the official seal of the recommending organization.(7) Proof of Language Proficiency (refer to the "Language Proficiency Requirements for Admission" in the application conditions)(VIII) Personal Statement. Write in Chinese or English, with no less than 800 words. The content should include: personal profile, study experience, study goals in China and research plan. Personal statements written in other languages should be accompanied by Chinese or English translations.(9) foreigners physical check form, please to download the following web page: https://oce.fzu.edu.cn/info/1025/7674.htmThe physical examination report must be pasted with the individual's photo, stamped with the hospital's official seal and covering the lower edge of the photo. The validity period is within six months.(10) Certificate of no criminal record. It is usually within six months prior to the date of application submission.(11) Other papers, awards, scientific research achievements, skill qualification certificates and other documents, as well as certificates of participation in cultural and sports exchange activities, etc. Please note: Applicants for Xiamen University of Arts and Design must provide one work related to the applied major.(12) Those who have not received scholarship support may come to the school for study at their own expense. After obtaining the admission qualification, it is necessary to supplement and submit the financial guarantee for studying in China and the financial guarantor in China to prove that they can bear the reasonable expenses such as study, life and international travel during the study in China.The financial guarantee for studying in China shall be in accordance with the subsidy amount of the Fujian Provincial Government's Foreign Student Scholarship, and the scanned copy of the bank's fixed deposit certificate shall prevail. The economic guarantor for coming to China is limited to the applicant's parents or relatives, and they must provide scanned copies of the corresponding passports or identification documents.
